environment.conditions: Fresh local git archives compare base 2d443187 with the committed final query-scope candidate. Both revisions receive identical final sql_query_scope, sql_identifiers, and query_latency fixtures. Sequential fresh release builds reuse the shared repository target only after every archived Rust source and Cargo.toml is touched; each compiler artifact must report fresh:false and is copied immediately, with distinct binary hashes required. Correctness runs do not use --nocapture and finish before timing. The three scope tests and six pinned identifier regressions use small disposable local fixtures. Five alternating process pairs retain all 50 samples for each of five unchanged REST shapes, plus full logs and /usr/bin/time -l counters. Cache eviction is not forced. No concurrent builds/tests, production data, external targets, network services, volumes, or live peers are used.
